Q: Unwanted cell selection in DataGridView when closing ContexMenuStrip A:

I declared a Boolean variable, FattoClic, which is used to differentiate the execution of the Dgv_Trovati_CellMouseDown routine depending on its value.

I implemented the CMStrip_Cerca_Closing routine, which sets FattoClic to True when CMStrip_Cerca is closed without making any selection within CMStrip_Cerca itself.

  • FattoClic is a Boolean variable

  • Dgv_Trovati is a DatagridView

  • CMStrip_Cerca is a ContexMenuStrip

    '... FattoClic serve per diversificare l'esecuzione della routine Dgv_Trovati_CellMouseDown in base al valore che assume...
    Dim FattoClic As Boolean = False

    Private Sub CMStrip_Cerca_Closing(sender As Object, e As ToolStripDropDownClosingEventArgs) Handles CMStrip_Cerca.Closing
        '... imposta FattoClic a True se la chiusura del menu è dovuta non da un clic su una voce di menu, ma da un clic sinistro
        'su una cella o un'altra area dell'applicazione...
        Try
            If e.CloseReason = ToolStripDropDownCloseReason.AppClicked Then
                FattoClic = True
            End If
        Catch
            '... se non disponibile CloseReason...
            FattoClic = True
        End Try
    End Sub

    Private Sub Dgv_Trovati_CellMouseDown(sender As Object, e As DataGridViewCellMouseEventArgs) Handles Dgv_Trovati.CellMouseDown
        If e.RowIndex = -1 OrElse e.ColumnIndex = -1 OrElse e.Clicks <> 1 Then Return

        '...se FattoClic è True significa che, mentre CMStrip_Cerca era visibile, si fatto clic sinistro su una cella di DGV_Trovati senza scegliere
        'alcuna voce del menu contestuale CMStrip_Cerca, pertanto per evitare che questa routine venga eseguita due volte, viene impostato FattoClic a
        'False e viene selezionata la cella corrente (se la modalità di selezione di DGV_TRovati è RowHeaderSelect, altrimenti non viene eseguita
        'nessuna azione, poiché nel caso di SelectionMode FullRowSelect la riga corrente è già selezionata) e quindi viene eseguito il Return per
        'uscire dalla routine...
        If FattoClic AndAlso e.Button = MouseButtons.Left Then
            FattoClic = False
            If Me.Dgv_Trovati.SelectionMode = DataGridViewSelectionMode.RowHeaderSelect AndAlso Me.Dgv_Trovati.CurrentCell IsNot Nothing Then
                Me.Dgv_Trovati.Item(Me.Dgv_Trovati.CurrentCell.ColumnIndex, Me.Dgv_Trovati.CurrentCell.RowIndex).Selected = True
            End If
            Return
        End If

        Dim SelezionaInteraRiga As Boolean = Me.Dgv_Trovati.SelectionMode = DataGridViewSelectionMode.FullRowSelect
        If e.Button = MouseButtons.Right Then
            '... quando si fa clic con il tasto destro su Dgv_Trovati, seleziona la cella su cui si è fatto clic...
            With Me.Dgv_Trovati
                If .SelectedCells.Count = 1 Then
                    .Item(e.ColumnIndex, e.RowIndex).Selected = True
                    .CurrentCell = .Item(e.ColumnIndex, e.RowIndex)
                ElseIf SelezionaInteraRiga Then
                    .Rows(e.RowIndex).Selected = True
                    .CurrentCell = .Item(e.ColumnIndex, e.RowIndex)
                End If
            End With

        ElseIf e.Button = MouseButtons.Left AndAlso Not KeysControlOrShiftTrue Then

            With Me.Dgv_Trovati
                .Item(e.ColumnIndex, e.RowIndex).Selected = True
                .CurrentCell = .Item(e.ColumnIndex, e.RowIndex)
                If SelezionaInteraRiga Then
                    .Rows(e.RowIndex).Selected = True
                    .CurrentCell = .Item(e.ColumnIndex, e.RowIndex)
                End If
            End With
        End If
    End Sub

Q: SettingWithCopyWarning: DataFrame.iterrows using .loc - pandas views vs copy A:

There is a lot to unpack here. But the core issue is that you are trying to set a value on a slice of a dataframe.

The documentation on iterrows states: You should never modify something you are iterating over. This is not guaranteed to work in all cases. Depending on the data types, the iterator returns a copy and not a view, and writing to it will have no effect.

You should try a vectorized approach instead of iteration.

# NOTE ALL OF THIS IS OUTSIDE OF ITERROWS LOOP
df.loc[df['description'].str.contains("^Output for field 1"), 'Display'] = "001bis"

filtered_df = df[~df['description'].str.contains("Menu items: Language names", regex=True, na=False)]

Final Notes

  • The issue has nothing to do with Tkinter which doesn't appear in any of the provided code.
  • The warnings were correct, the misunderstanding was the origin of them (use of iterrows vs loc by itself).
  • Vectorized approaches should also improve speed versus looping.
  • Be sure to use consistent naming, "description" is used in code, but is "Description" in example df.

Q: WebApplicationBuilder: What triggers launchUrl to actually launch the browser? A:

As far as I could research, this could be caused because you are using WebApplication.CreateEmptyBuilder, instead of WebApplication.CreateBuilder.

So you don't use default implementations for Kestrel that are in ASP.NET framework.

Indeed, if you'd use this method on new project, you would get runtime errors that implementations for IServer were not provided. And when you use WebApplication.CreateBuilder, then we have implementation provided in class Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel.Core.KestrelServerImpl
